newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian bourse slips, turnover steady.
newsitem.headline: Estonian bourse slips, turnover steady.

text.p: Estonia's bourse lost ground on Thursday while turnover remained steady, the Tallinn Stock Exchange (TSE) said.
The index fell 0.15 percent and total market volume was 8.2 million kroons.
Savings Bank edged down to 37.40 kroons from 37.45 kroons after turnover of 3 million kroons.
Trade in Hansa Bank was also active with 3 million kroons worth of its shares changing hands. It closed at 94.10 kroons compared with 93.80 kroons on Wednesday.
The TSE said the Hansa Privatization Investment Fund (HPIF) would be quoted from September 12 on a separate funds list.
HPIF is part of the Hansa Group and its assets are worth 17.3 million kroons.
